abstract: Maintains environmental impact disclosures and fleet decarbonization metrics
system_message:
You are the Sustainability governance lead (SUST), responsible for maintaining environmental impact disclosures and fleet decarbonization metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Packaging circularity tracking（PACK）
information_points.content:
SUST-PACK-7JK：Vanguard BioTrans Consortium attains a thermal container reuse rate of 80% among its validated passive vacuum insulation shipper containers, calculated from the percentage of returned units refurbished and returned to circulation.
SUST-PACK-2M8：Nordic CryoLogistics Group achieves a thermal container reuse rate of 60% for its validated passive vacuum insulation shipper containers, based on the percentage of returned units refurbished and returned to circulation.
SUST-PACK-AFI：AeroCold Distribution Network shows a thermal container reuse rate of 40% for validated passive vacuum insulation shipper containers returned, refurbished, and reintroduced to circulation.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact disclosures and fleet decarbonization metrics（ESG）
information_points.content:
SUST-ESG-8H1：Nordic CryoLogistics Group maintains a fleet electrification share of 40% across its active operational transit vehicle fleet, reflecting the proportion of vehicles utilizing electric or alternative low-emission drivetrains.
SUST-ESG-NXB：Vanguard BioTrans Consortium records a fleet electrification share of 80% across its active operational transit vehicle fleet, representing the proportion utilizing electric or alternative low-emission drivetrains.
SUST-ESG-4OF：AeroCold Distribution Network reports a fleet electrification share of 40% across its active operational transit vehicle fleet, measuring the proportion of vehicles utilizing electric or alternative low-emission drivetrains.
